title: Move a guest's chats and credits to the account they link
whatToBuild: A guest who signs up or signs in keeps their work: linkGuest, exported from packages/auth/src/server.js and passed to the anonymous plugin as onLinkAccount in packages/auth/src/config.js, moves every chat of the anonymous user to the new user and adds the guest's credit balance to the new user's, before the anonymous user is deleted.
testBoundaries: linkGuest through its export from packages/auth/src/server.js, in test/ with node:test, over in-memory chat and ai_credit tables

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every chat of the anonymous user belongs to the new user after the link
The guest's credits are added to the new user's balance, or become it when the new user has none
